items.title: Syntax canary for SQL-like inputs
items.context: A scalar input suspected of reaching a SQL/ORM query
items.intended_use: Trigger a parser/validation differential only; pair with an unchanged and type-valid control
caveats: A quote error is not SQL injection; WAF and input validation must be excluded
items.safety: Authorized testing only. Use designated identities, synthetic data, the least-impacting proof, and stop on unexpected effects.

items.title: Harmless template arithmetic marker
items.context: A confirmed server-rendered template candidate; delimiter must match the identified engine
items.intended_use: Determine whether constant arithmetic is evaluated rather than rendered literally
caveats: Never access objects, globals, files, environment, network, or process APIs
items.safety: Authorized testing only. Use designated identities, synthetic data, the least-impacting proof, and stop on unexpected effects.

items.title: CRLF inert response-header marker
items.context: A response-header value on an isolated request
items.intended_use: Check whether one inert synthetic header is created after decoding
caveats: Do not inject cookies, redirects, cache directives, or split response bodies
items.safety: Authorized testing only. Use designated identities, synthetic data, the least-impacting proof, and stop on unexpected effects.
